resources.string: Experimental local accessibility compatibility trigger for published support profiles. The service does not read or store accessibility events or nodes.

Compatibility depends on the target app version, page, and device, and may stop working after an update. This service cannot create semantic nodes that a page does not expose. Controls in WebView, Canvas, and custom-drawn interfaces may remain unavailable.

Some affected apps may decide whether to expose normal nodes based on the implementation class name of an enabled service. This plugin contains the experimental compatibility class name required by its current support profiles: com.google.android.accessibility.selecttospeak.SelectToSpeakService. It is not Google Select to Speak and is not affiliated with Google. AutoJs6 still reads and acts on nodes through its own accessibility service.
Optional experimental companion that may help AutoJs6 retrieve accessibility nodes from supported apps. It runs locally, ignores every event, and does not guarantee nodes on every page

The service callback is a no-op. The plugin does not read event sources, event text, root nodes, screenshots, or user content. It does not store or share data and has no network access. The service receives events only from packages in the published support list.
